statement: Threshold and positive-energy bound states of the BFSS matrix model. Proves that the undeformed relative $`\mathrm{SU}(N)`$ BFSS model has exactly one normalizable zero-energy state for every finite N ≥ 2, resolving the threshold-bound-state conjecture. For $`\mathrm{SU}(2)`$, a companion proves infinitely many normalizable positive-energy eigenstates with unbounded energies, contradicting the original BFSS paper's exclusion of additional bound states at N = 2.
